input: We are building the Uber for dog walking. Uber hit a $60B valuation, so even 1% of that market is huge.

An internal dashboard that shows, for each of our on-call rotations, the median time from page to first human acknowledgement over the last 90 days, pulled from the paging provider's API. On-call leads asked for it twice in retros.

expect.notes: Plausible internal tool with a stated requester and a single metric. The pass condition is that Keep credits the narrow scope and the API source, and that findings attack the pitch's own definitions rather than inventing user reactions. Verified 2026-09-08: it returned Needs surgery on three legitimate definitional gaps (which provider event counts as a human ack, median hiding the tail the stated audience cares about, rotation membership drift across the 90-day window). A three-sentence pitch with an undefined central metric earns that verdict, so Needs surgery is allowed. EVAL HYGIENE: the original input described a Trello grooming-brief CLI, and on 2026-09-08 the model correctly returned 'Nope' because an installed skill named groom-prep does exactly that, quoting its registered description. That was a right answer to a contaminated question: the ambient session's skill list is visible to the model under test, so a case must not describe anything resembling an installed skill or command. Rewritten to avoid the collision.

input: Replace our Redis job queue with Postgres SKIP LOCKED. One fewer service to run, and we do about 2,000 jobs a minute.

expect.notes: 2k jobs/min is well within SKIP LOCKED. The pass condition is that it does NOT invent a throughput ceiling and that Keep accepts the primitive. Verified 2026-09-08: Keep said outright 'this isn't a scale mismatch, it's a well-worn technique for exactly this throughput', then found two real gaps (the pitch names the dequeue primitive but not the retries, scheduling, and dead-lettering the Redis library was providing; no retention story for a hot jobs table). Needs surgery is allowed on that basis. Compare R7, which is the same technique presented with a load test and a stated backoff and dead-letter design.

Sound diff with tests that cover the security property and the old empty/null failure mode. Zero findings is the ideal answer; one is allowed. The 2026-09-06 pre-tune run padded three. If this drifts to 'Worth a cheap test' the model is inventing a gap.
